mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decline occurs in >50% of cases but 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of those instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly housing starts exceeding 1400.0 thousand units indicate robust consumer spending and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1400.0 occurs in >50% of cases but 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in payroll employment and unemployment rate signal labor market tightening that precedes corporate profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS and UNRATE both rise but 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of cases, or interaction term coefficient p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) triggers Federal Reserve monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 2.5 occurs in >50% of cases but 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates strengthening economic fundamentals that support corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth occurs in >50% of cases but 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100.0 signals manufacturing contraction, which typically precedes economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100.0 occurs in >50% of cases but 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: Joint decline in federal funds rate and CPIAUCSL indicates dovish monetary policy combined with disinflation, reducing real interest rates and boosting equity valuations for positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both decline but 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of cases, or interaction term coefficient p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) indicates tight labor market conditions that drive corporate profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 3.5 occurs in >50% of cases but 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of those instances.
